title: Why Nike's Perfect Comeback Isn't Working
summary: Nike’s CEO did everything the turnaround playbook says to do. So why is the company still getting worse?*How to prevent your business from falling like Nike:* https://clickhubspot.com/yaz1Kylian Mbappé just left Nike for On. Around the same time, the stock hit a decade low and got dropped from the S&P 100 after almost two decades. Now CEO Elliott Hill came out of retirement in 2024, reversed the direct-to-consumer overhaul, and won back retail partners. But the real problem started before he returned. When Nike reorganized around the online shopper, it changed which shoes it made, and the people who made them. Designers left for rivals. The company burned through three chief innovation officers in three years.
